```{r tab-qc}
#| echo: false
qc <- RD("results", "qc", "qc_summary.tsv")
qc$adapter_pct <- NULL
names(qc) <- c("run", "sample", "condition", "reads_before", "reads_after", "pct_passed",
               "low_quality_reads", "too_short_reads", "q30_before", "q30_after")
tbl(qc)
```

```{r tab-quant}
#| echo: false
q <- RD("results", "qc", "salmon_libtype.tsv")
q$multimap_or_orphan <- NULL

```

```{r tab-readfate}
#| echo: false
rf <- RD("results", "qc", "postmap", "read_fate.tsv")
out <- data.frame(
  sample = rf$sample,
  reads = rf$reads_total,
  mapped_e2e_pct = round(100 * rf$mapped_genome_e2e / rf$reads_total, 2),
  unmapped_pct = round(100 * rf$unmapped_e2e / rf$reads_total, 2),
  recovered_local_pct_of_library = round(100 * rf$recovered_local / rf$reads_total, 2),
  plasmid_or_adapter_pct_of_library = round(100 * rf$diag_hits / rf$reads_total, 2),
  unexplained_pct_of_library = round(100 * (rf$residual_after_local - rf$diag_hits) / rf$reads_total, 2))
tbl(out)
```
